name: Matter Manipulator MKII
description:
The MKII is the penultimate upgrade in the Matter Manipulator line. It is much more powerful, storing §210x§r the power, with a range of §2128 Blocks§r, and the ability to place §2256 Blocks/Second§r. In addition to all of the MKI features you now unlock §5§ltwo powerful new modes§r:

- §5§lCopy / Paste§r: Copy a selection of blocks and paste it as many times as you'd like. Works best with GT & AE2.

- §5§lMove§r: Similar to Copy / Paste, but will physically relocate something already built.

Here is a short list of things that are copied / moved with the MM, the more complete list is on the Readme, but this should give you a general idea of how versatile it is.

§3§lGregTech:§r
- Pipe/Cable connections
- Machine color
- Machine front & output directions
- Basic machine settings (auto outputs, etc)
- Hatch settings (sorting, stack limiting, etc)
- Multi machine settings (void protection, batch mode, etc)
- Multi rotation
- Covers
- Strong redstone output
- Custom names
- Ghost circuits
- Bus/hatch item/fluid lock
- Modes (for machines that use the new mode system)
- Data stick data
- TecTech machine input parameters
- ME output bus/hatch capacity

§3§lAE2:§r
- Any coloring
- The orientation
- The configuration
- The upgrades
- Custom names
- Any stored cells (will also automatically configure cells & install their upgrades)
- Any patterns (will encode but not decode patterns)
- Priority Settings
- P2P Settings
- OreDict / Regular Filter

§9§3§lAdvanced Copy Options:§r 

When in Copy / Paste mode, the radial menu has an §5§lAdvanced Options§r sub-menu with two powerful toggles:
  - §5§l§5§lLink to External Hubs§r: When copying wireless connectors that are linked to a hub outside of the copy region, the pasted connectors will stay linked to that original hub.
  - §5§lAuto-P2P Interfaces§r: Replaces ME Interfaces in the copied region with P2P ME tunnels, automatically placing matching tunnels at the source for seamless item routing.
